instruction.name: x86inctop
instruction.description: Increment the x87 top-of-stack pointer (FINCSTP), wrapping modulo 8.

notes: LBT x87 top-of-stack increment. No register result, so only the rate is recorded.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 50 --unroll2 200 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r12, 5' --asm 'x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop'
throughput.notes: Consecutive copies chain through the top-of-stack pointer, so the measured rate is also the latency.
